answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 43401 Country: India Title: salah Question: I have some doubts regarding salah with Jamah. (1) Should muqtadi recite sana, ruku and sajdah tasbih, tashahhud, durood and dua in siri and jehri salah when he is behind imam or else he should be quiet. What should he do I know that he should not recite the holy Quran. I am a woman so I never read salah behind imam. Now I want to teach my son. So please clarify my doubts. Answer ID: 43401 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 221/171/B=1434) While offering salah with Jamah a muqtadi shall read sana, other tasbihat, al-tahiyat, durood etc in all silent and loud salah except qirah. على المقتدى ان يتابع إمامه فى كل اذكار الصلوة عدا القرآة فلا يتابع امامه فيها بل يستمع وينصت سواء كانت الصلوة سرية او جهرية ، (الفقه الحنفى في ثوبه الجديد 1:272 ط دارالايمان) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
